core_obligations: Reduce to the case of a covering by two opens V and W by induction on the number of members of the cover (proof lines 8371-8380).
Show that (K_n|_U) is essentially constant with value K using the distinguished triangles of the j-star exact sequence and 2-out-of-3 for essential constancy (proof lines 8382-8394).

Set up the Mayer-Vietoris diagram, apply Lemma labelled lemma-lift-map to all horizontal arrows but the middle one and the 5-lemma to conclude the middle isomorphism, then deduce pro-isomorphism using the existence of a Deligne system with value K and the characterisation of pro-isomorphism by colimits of Hom (proof lines 8396-8425).
proof_roadmap: Induction reducing the cover to two opens (proof lines 8371-8380).
Essential constancy of the system on U (proof lines 8382-8394).
The Mayer-Vietoris diagram and the 5-lemma (proof lines 8396-8420).
difficulty_reason: For an open immersion j : U -> X of Noetherian schemes and an inverse system (K_n) in D^b_Coh(O_X), the lemma asserts that (K_n) is pro-isomorphic to a Deligne system if and only if each restriction (K_n|W_i) is pro-isomorphic to a Deligne system with respect to U cap W_i -> W_i, for an open covering X = W_1 cup ... cup W_r (statement lines 8357-8369). The proof is by induction on r: the case r = 1 is clear, and for r > 1 one sets V = W_1 cup ... cup W_{r-1} and applies the induction hypothesis to reduce to the case of a covering by two opens V and W (proof lines 8371-8380). Assuming (K_n|V) and (K_n|W) are pro-isomorphic to Deligne systems, the proof notes that the same holds on V cap W because restrictions to opens preserve Deligne systems, so the pro-systems on U cap V, U cap W and U cap V cap W are essentially constant, and the distinguished triangles of Cohomology, Lemma labelled cohomology-lemma-exact-sequence-j-star together with Derived Categories, Lemma labelled derived-lemma-essentially-constant-2-out-of-3 show that (K_n|_U) is essentially constant with value K (proof lines 8382-8394). For an arbitrary L in D^b_Coh(O_X) the proof then writes a five row diagram of colimits of Ext^{-1} and Hom over V, W, V cap W and their intersections with U, whose vertical sequences are exact by Cohomology, Lemma labelled cohomology-lemma-mayer-vietoris-hom and exactness of filtered colimits, and whose horizontal arrows are isomorphisms except the middle one by Lemma labelled lemma-lift-map and the invariance of colimits under pro-isomorphism, so the 5-lemma makes the middle arrow an isomorphism as well (proof lines 8396-8420). This shows that (K_n) is pro-isomorphic to a Deligne system for K: taking a Deligne system (K'_n) with constant value K on U, which exists by Lemma labelled lemma-extension-by-zero, one has the same colimit of Hom_X(K'_n, L), so the two pro-systems are pro-isomorphic by Categories, Remark labelled categories-remark-pro-category-copresheaves (proof lines 8422-8425). Setting up the Mayer-Vietoris diagram so that the 5-lemma identifies the middle arrow, and then concluding pro-isomorphism from equality of colimits of Hom, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
